provenance.note: 31 December UTC daily close, Coin Metrics PriceUSD, 2010-2025 (nominal USD, no inflation adjustment). The 2010 value ($0.30) is Bitcoin's genuinely sub-$1 year-end price that year, not a placeholder. Source dataset itself cautions 2010-2011 prices come from thin, less-standardized early markets and are less comparable to later years; marked here as a secondary (non-exchange-official) aggregator series, not estimated/fabricated.
